baseline_construction_method.value: A supervised energy-consumption (steam flow, QS) predictive model was fitted as the energy baseline using the Gradient Boosting Machines (GBM) regression algorithm on the 2020 baseline-period data. Relevant variables were identified from process knowledge, then reduced by multicollinearity analysis and univariate/DBSCAN outlier removal, min-max standardised, and ranked by random-forest feature importance (8 final variables); GBM hyper-parameters were tuned (n_estimators=500, learning_rate=0.01, max_depth=20) with an 80%/20% train-validation split.
